_comment: Skill-vocab chunk 3 smoke content: a channeled cooldown that revives the nearest downed player at their corpse with 30% HP. Second cast-time consumer (castTicks) — the precondition (a corpse in range) is re-checked at cast completion; castInterruptedByDamage means being attacked mid-channel breaks it. No corpse in range = rejected activation, no cooldown burned. The REAL Revive (rarity, cost) is step-6 content. Cheat-granted (SKILL Revive), no milestone. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
